items.title: Onlend Unveils No-Code Infrastructure to Launch Custom Onchain Lending Apps
items.summary: Built by a team with experience scaling a leading DeFi lending protocol, Onlend aims to make it easier for fintechs, asset managers, curators, and asset issuers to build and operate their own lending products. Onlend has publicly unveiled its decentralised infrastructure platform designed to let anyone create, launch, and operate their own onchain lending applications without building the underlying technology from scratch. items.title: September job openings, hires, and total separations change little; quits increase
items.summary: The number of job openings was little changed at 7.5 million in September. Hires and total separations changed little at 5.4 million and 5.3 million, respectively. Quits increased to 3.4 million, while layoffs and discharges changed little at 1.6 million.

items.summary: Mutsamudu, Comoros, November 3, 2026 – MEXC, a pioneer in 0-fee digital asset trading, announced an upgrade to Futures Earn. This product helps retail traders use their capital more efficiently by allowing eligible futures account balances to earn interest while users continue trading. The upgrade is designed to improve the overall user experience and make the product easier to understand and use.
